title: ControllerConfig
description: Startup configuration for the Agentdesktop fleet controller.

adminListen.description: Loopback address on which the controller management UI listens.

allowInsecureDev.description:
Permit a non-HTTPS OIDC issuer for isolated local development.

This escape hatch is only appropriate for isolated local development.

browserEgress.description:
Browser proxy (PAC) reporting. Devices always report the PAC their
browser policy sets; these settings add a compliance check shown in
the management UI.

daemonConfig.description: Daemon configuration distributed to enrolled devices.

databaseUrl.description: SQLite or PostgreSQL URL used for controller state.

fleetListen.description: Address on which the device-facing gRPC fleet API listens.

oidc.description: OpenID Connect settings used for device enrollment and authorization.

tls.description:
TLS identities used by the device-facing fleet API.

A string selects a directory containing `controller.pem`,
`controller-key.pem`, `device-ca.pem`, and `device-ca-key.pem`.

usage.description: Token and cost collection from agentgateway access logs.

BrowserEgressCompliance.description: Expected browser proxy settings for the compliance check.

pacUrl.description: The PAC URL browser policy is expected to set (exact match).

ControllerBrowserEgressConfig.description: Browser proxy (PAC) settings of the controller.

compliance.description:
Compliance check: the controller compares the PAC each device's
browser policy sets with these values and shows the result in the
management UI. Agentdesktop does not configure browsers from them.

ControllerDaemonConfig.description: Controller-owned daemon configuration file and its revision.

path.description:
Path to the watched YAML configuration distributed to enrolled devices.

Relative paths are resolved from the controller configuration directory.
Valid file changes are published to connected devices automatically.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing revision assigned to the daemon configuration.

ControllerGatewayJwtConfig.description: Settings for issuing short-lived LLM gateway JWTs.

issuer.description: Issuer claim placed in generated JWTs.

keyId.description: Key identifier placed in generated JWT headers.

lifetime.description: Lifetime of generated JWTs. Defaults to `5m`.

privateKey.description:
Path to the PEM-encoded RSA private signing key.

Relative paths are resolved from the controller configuration directory.

ControllerOidcConfig.description: OpenID Connect settings used for interactive device enrollment.

redirectUri.description: Redirect URI registered for the native enrollment client.

ControllerTlsConfig.description: TLS configuration for the fleet API and device certificate issuer.

anyOf.description: Directory containing the four standard TLS files.
Explicit paths to each TLS file.

ControllerTlsFiles.description: Explicit TLS file paths for the fleet API and device certificate issuer.

certificate.description:
Path to the PEM-encoded TLS certificate chain.

Relative paths are resolved from the controller configuration directory.

clientCaCertificate.description: PEM CA roots used to verify issued device client certificates.

clientCaKey.description:
PEM private key used to issue device certificates from `clientCaCertificate`.

Enrolled daemons generate their own private key and send a CSR.

key.description:
Path to the PEM-encoded TLS private key.

Relative paths are resolved from the controller configuration directory.

ControllerUsageConfig.description:
Collection of LLM token and cost records that agentgateway exports to the
fleet API as OTLP access logs over gRPC.

tokenFile.description:
Path to a file containing the bearer token agentgateway sends with each export. The token must be at least 32 characters.

Relative paths are resolved from the controller configuration directory.
